# Quran Tasheeh

> A recitation practice app at https://quran.mushafuk.online: read the Quran with a microphone and check mistakes and tajweed. Part of Mushafuk (https://mushafuk.online).

This host is a browser app (progressive web app). It is not a mushaf library and it does not publish tafsir or translations. The Madinah mushaf and the other Mushafuk reading sites are at https://mushafuk.online/.

## Start here

- [Quran Tasheeh](https://quran.mushafuk.online/)
- [Madinah mushaf](https://mushafuk.online/)

## Languages

The app interface is Azerbaijani. The Quran text is Arabic.
